sharedRules.name: Steel Guard
sharedRules.description: Always pass Infantry Saves on [shield] and [bloc] and roll one die for each point of Damage the Unit takes, negating one point of damage for each [bloc] rolled. Steel Guard may only join Steel Guard.

sharedRules.name: Officer
sharedRules.description: May take Officer Special Actions to reactivate or rearm their troops.

sharedRules.name: Tesla
sharedRules.description: Place Stunned token on Unit hit by this weapon, Unit must perform a Nothing Action as its first Action next Activation, removing all Stunned tokens.

sharedRules.name: Brave
sharedRules.description: Roll three dice when Rallying.

sharedRules.name: Commissar
sharedRules.description: Joins Infantry Unit for the duration of the game. Each Unit may only have on Commissar attached to it.

sharedRules.name: Tracked
sharedRules.description: Can be affected by type of Terrain crossed. (See Terrain Table)

sharedRules.name: Damage Resilient
sharedRules.description: Roll one die for each point of Damage the Unit takes, negating one point for each [bloc] rolled. Does not apply to Units Joined.

sharedRules.name: Advanced Reactive Fire
sharedRules.description: Can attempt a Reactive Attack at up to Range 6, counting [shield] and [bloc] when rolling for number of Actions. Does not apply to units joined.

sharedRules.name: Airmobile
sharedRules.description: Can be carried by an Airlifter.

sharedRules.name: Cheat Death
sharedRules.description: If eliminated, roll a die. On a [bloc] or [shield], cancel one point of Damage and Hero survives, but gains a Stunned token.

sharedRules.name: Combat Medic
sharedRules.description: Can use the Medic Special Actions like a Command Squad Medic. Can be used on a unit joined.

sharedRules.name: Defensive Tactics
sharedRules.description: Gains Damage Resiliance when in cover.

sharedRules.name: Flame
sharedRules.description: Target gets no saves from this weapon and is suppressed.

sharedRules.name: Grenade
sharedRules.description: Target Infantry receive no Cover Save from this weapon but still receive Infantry Save.

sharedRules.name: Killing Spree
sharedRules.description: When Hero hits with Ranged Weapon, roll again scoring another hit on [bloc]. Continue rolling until fail to hit. Does not Apply to Units Joined.

sharedRules.name: Lucky
sharedRules.description: Once per game, may re-roll all of the dice for one weapon during his Attack action.

sharedRules.name: Mechanic Crew
sharedRules.description: Perform a Makeshift repair Action to roll one die for each Miniature in the Unit. Cancel one point of damage on an adjacent vehicle for each [bloc] rolled. Does not apply to Units Joined.

sharedRules.name: Mercenary
sharedRules.description: Unit can be fielded by any Bloc.

sharedRules.name: Smoke Launchers
sharedRules.description: Once per game, take a free Smoke Launcher Action to place Smoke on Unit.

sharedRules.name: Support Weapon
sharedRules.description: Support Weapons have multiple Soldiers on the same base. Surviving Soldiers choose which weapons to use.

sharedRules.name: Air Assault
sharedRules.description: Can be carried by an Airlifter and Activate after the Airlifter carrying it to Dismount and Move.

sharedRules.name: Charge
sharedRules.description: May take a free Close-Combat Action after performing a March Move Action.

sharedRules.name: Cutting
sharedRules.description: When weapon hits, roll again scoring another hit on a [bloc]. Keep rolling until failing to hit.

sharedRules.name: Engineer Vehicle
sharedRules.description: Has improved Engineering Action.

sharedRules.name: Grapple
sharedRules.description: Targets Hit by this weapon gain a Stunned Token.

sharedRules.name: Mechanic
sharedRules.description: Can use Makeshift Repair Action.

sharedRules.name: Scout
sharedRules.description: Take March Move Action as first Action of game and recieve one extra Action for that Activation.

sharedRules.name: Ace Pilot
sharedRules.description: May mount a Vehicle, using his skills while mounted. Roll one die when Vehicle Activates gaining a third action on a [bloc] or a [crosshair].

sharedRules.name: Air Alert
sharedRules.description: Take Air Alert Special Action to select an Aircraft in Line of Sight. On a [bloc], friendly Units attacking it hit on [crosshair] as well as [bloc] for the remainder of the turn.

sharedRules.name: Air Traffic Control
sharedRules.description: To take an Air Traffic Control Special Action, select an Aircraft in line of sight and on a result of [bloc] the selected Aircraft activates again.

sharedRules.name: And Stay Down
sharedRules.description: Any Unit Hit by ranged weapons fired by this Unit automatically gains a Suppression token.

sharedRules.name: Artillery
sharedRules.description: Can fire under control of an Artillery Observer. Ignores infantry save.

sharedRules.name: Artillery Observer
sharedRules.description: Can shoot a target in Line of Sight with an Artillery Weapon from another Unit that has not yet Activated, even if the other Unit does not have Line of Sight. The other Unit is counted as Activated after making its Attack.

sharedRules.name: Assassin
sharedRules.description: Choose Soldiers hit using Close-Combat Weapons. Does not apply to Units Joined.

sharedRules.name: At the Double
sharedRules.description: May take a free Move Action after performing a March Move. Applies to Units Joined.

sharedRules.name: Berserk
sharedRules.description: When Close-Combat Weapon Hits, roll again scoring another hit on a [bloc]. Keep rolling until failing to hit.

sharedRules.name: Black Ops
sharedRules.description: Rolls four dice for initiative.

sharedRules.name: Camouflage
sharedRules.description: Take Camouflage Special Action. Unit cannor be attacked at Range or higher. Ends if Unit takes any Action other than a Move or Nothing Action. Start the game Camouflaged. Does not share it with any Unit Joined.

sharedRules.name: Command Squad
sharedRules.description: May perform Special Actions with its Officer, Medic, or Mechanic to reactivate, heal, repair, or rearm Units.

sharedRules.name: Command Vehicle
sharedRules.description: Officers, Mechanics, and Medics mounted in vehicle can re-roll Special Actions.

sharedRules.name: Dozer Blade
sharedRules.description: Take a Dozer Special Action to gain a Cover Save until the vehicle takes a Move or March Move Action.

sharedRules.name: Expert
sharedRules.description: Hits on [crosshair] as well as [bloc].

sharedRules.name: Fighting Spirit
sharedRules.description: Once per game, hit on [crosshair] as well as [bloc]. Also applies to Units Joined.

sharedRules.name: First Strike
sharedRules.description: Resolves Close-Combat Attacks before target resolves theirs.

sharedRules.name: Flying
sharedRules.description: Unit ignores terrain. Does not share with units joined.

sharedRules.name: Helicopter
sharedRules.description: Helicopters are not required to take a Move Action, allowing them to make sustained attacks.

sharedRules.name: Infantry Ace
sharedRules.description: Roll one die when unit activates gaining a third action on a [bloc] or a [crosshair].

sharedRules.name: Loner
sharedRules.description: May not Join a Unit.

sharedRules.name: Move and Fire
sharedRules.description: May take free Move Action before or after a Sustained Attack Action or a free Attack Action before of acfter a March Move Action.

sharedRules.name: Naval Unit
sharedRules.description: Treats Water as Open Terrain but cannot enter any other type of terrain. May take a free Attack Action after performing a March Move Action.

sharedRules.name: Nothin's Easy
sharedRules.description: Does not gain Under fire or Suppression. Applies to Units Joined.

sharedRules.name: Passengers (6)
sharedRules.description: Can carry six Infantry with Armour 1 or 2 or three Infantry with Armour 3 or 4.

sharedRules.name: Phaser
sharedRules.description: Targets get no Cover Save from this weapon but still receive Infantry Save.

sharedRules.name: Pilot
sharedRules.description: May mount a Vehicle and use skills while mounted.

sharedRules.name: Power Scope
sharedRules.description: Hits on [crosshair] as well as [bloc] when using ranged weapons when making a Sustained Attack. Does not appy to Units Joined.

sharedRules.name: Reload
sharedRules.description: When this weapon performs an Attack Action, remove it's Reload Token. The Unit may not perform another Attack Action until a Reload Action is performed.

sharedRules.name: Salvo
sharedRules.description: May double number of attack dice in an Attack but must be reloaded with a Reload Action prior to next use.

sharedRules.name: Savage Animal
sharedRules.description: Hits on [crosshair] and [bloc].

sharedRules.name: Small Vehicle
sharedRules.description: Always has Cover save. Determines and affects Line of Sight as an Infantry Unit, but blocks LoS for other Small Vehicles.

sharedRules.name: Sealifter
sharedRules.description: Naval Unit equipped to carry Units into battle.

sharedRules.name: Sniper
sharedRules.description: Choose the enemy soldiers hit with this weapon. It Ignores Infantry and Cover saves.

sharedRules.name: Spotter
sharedRules.description: If Spotter does not use a weapon, each Sniper weapon making a Sustained Attack hits on rolls of [crosshair] as well as [bloc].

sharedRules.name: Spy
sharedRules.description: Not placed at the start of the game. Each time Spy is Activated, roll two dice. If any [bloc] are rolled, place the Spy within range one of an enemy Unit and perform one Action for each [bloc] rolled.

sharedRules.name: Strongpoint
sharedRules.description: Must be deployed in a Strongpoint or Bunker. Unit has a Strongpoint included in its points cost. You may upgrade the Strongpoint to a Bunker for an additional +5 points. Cannot move.

sharedRules.name: Super Human
sharedRules.description: Passes Infantry Save on [shield] as well as [bloc] and can benefit from Cover, but not at the same time. May not Join a Unit.

sharedRules.name: Trail Blazer
sharedRules.description: Can Move through enemy Units. Applies to Units Joined.

sharedRules.name: Volley
sharedRules.description: Weapon may fire all remaining ammunition at the same target in a Single Attack or Sustained Attack Action.

sharedRules.name: Ace Air Pilot
sharedRules.description: May mount an Aircraft, using his skills while mounted. Roll one die when the Aircraft Activates gaining a third action on a [bloc] or [crosshair].

sharedRules.name: Airborne
sharedRules.description: Airborne units are dropped anywhere on the table, but not closer than range 2 to any objective in the game. The Unit's first Action must by a Nothing Action. Player rolls one die and on a roll of [bloc] or [crosshair] the player may take a second action. Unit may not capture objectives on the first turn placed.

sharedRules.name: Blutkreuz
sharedRules.description: All mindless zombie units withing range 1 at the start of their activation increase their move to 3, their march move to 4, and gain charge.

sharedRules.name: Execute
sharedRules.description: Can take execute special action to eliminate chose soldier within Range 1 from a unit with a stunned token.

sharedRules.name: Flame Burst
sharedRules.description: Target get no saves from this weapon and is suppressed. Use blast template instead of flame template.

sharedRules.name: General
sharedRules.description: When joined to a Command Squad, this Hero rolls one extra dice when attempting Officer Special Actions.

sharedRules.name: Gorilla
sharedRules.description: Only a Gorilla may Join Gorillas.

sharedRules.name: Half-Tracked
sharedRules.description: Can be affected by type of Terrain crossed. (See Terrain Table)

sharedRules.name: Head Shot
sharedRules.description: Choose the enemy soldiers hit with this weapon. Place stunned token on unit hit by this weapon.

sharedRules.name: Interrogate
sharedRules.description: If Tina or a unit she joins uses a close-combat weapon to eliminate a hero or officer, or executes a hero or officer, roll four dice for initiative at the start of each turn for the rest of the game.

sharedRules.name: Jammer
sharedRules.description: All successful enemy Actions that require use of a radio within a range of 6, are forced to re-roll and accept the new result.

sharedRules.name: Laser
sharedRules.description: When weapon hits, roll again scoring another hit on a [bloc]. Keep rolling until failing to hit.

sharedRules.name: Mindless
sharedRules.description: Can be led by the Blutkreuz. Cannot take Objectives. Immune to Suppression. Applies to Unit Joined.

sharedRules.name: Passengers (12)
sharedRules.description: Can carry twelve Infantry with Armour 1 or 2 or six Infantry with Armour 3 or 4.

sharedRules.name: Passengers (3)
sharedRules.description: Can carry three Infantry with Armour 1 or 2 or one Infantry with Armour 3 or 4.

sharedRules.name: Resurrection
sharedRules.description: May take Resurrection Action on a Mindless Zombie Unit within Range 1. Unit rolls a die for each Zombie eliminated from the Unit. Each [bloc] returns one Zombie to the Unit.

sharedRules.name: Wheeled
sharedRules.description: Can be affected by type of Terrain crossed. (See Terrain Table)

sharedRules.name: Wire Guided
sharedRules.description: If unit Attacks with one Missile and no other weapons, it re-rolls misses for that missile as if making a Sustained Attack.

sharedRules.name: Zombie
sharedRules.description: Zombies always pass Infantry Saves on [shield] as well as [bloc]. Only a Zombie may Join Zombies.

sharedRules.name: Airlifter
sharedRules.description: Can carry an Air Assault or Airmobile Unit.

sharedRules.name: Assault Shield
sharedRules.description: When a Hit from a Close-Combat weapon is assigned to a miniature with an Assault Shield, roll a die. On a [bloc], cancel the Hit.

sharedRules.name: Follow Me
sharedRules.description: Can take a Follow Me Special Action once per turn. All friendly Infantry Units with Infantry Armour 1 or 2 within Range 2 and in Line of Sight roll a die. On a [bloc] they take an immediate Move Action with a Move rating of 2.

sharedRules.name: Get Moving You...
sharedRules.description: Succeeds on [crosshair] as well as [bloc] when using Get Moving You Bunch of Monkeys on a Spetsnaz Unit.

sharedRules.name: Medevac
sharedRules.description: Take a Medevac Action on a friendly Infantry Unit within Range 1. Roll a die for each Soldier eliminated from the Unit. Each roll of [bloc] returns one of Soldier to the Unit.

sharedRules.name: Radiation
sharedRules.description: Targets re-roll successful Saves against this weapon.

sharedRules.name: Red Banner
sharedRules.description: All friendly Infantry Units within Range 2 and in Line of Sight roll three dice when Rallying.

sharedRules.name: Take Aim
sharedRules.description: When making a Sustained Attack with ranged weapons hits on rolls of [crosshair] as well as [bloc]. Does not apply to Units Joined.

sharedRules.name: Stealth
sharedRules.description: Attacking with this weapon does not remove Camouflage.

sharedRules.name: Ace Gunner
sharedRules.description: Any Vehicle this Hero pilots gains Expert on all Weapons.

sharedRules.name: Assault Vehicle
sharedRules.description: Passengers in this Vehicle can Activate after the Vehicle has Activated.

sharedRules.name: Quick Recovery
sharedRules.description: Unit does not need to take a Nothing Action after using Airborne skill. A Unit share this skill with a Squad but not a Vehicle.

sharedRules.name: Radar
sharedRules.description: A vehicle with this equipment can reroll once any failed dice when making an Attack or Sustained Attack Action against an Aircraft.

sharedRules.name: Large Ordnance
sharedRules.description: Uses Artillery Template or targets four squares like Artillery.

sharedRules.name: Raid
sharedRules.description: The vehicle can spend all its Actions to do a Raid Special Action. It can do MOVE + ATTACK + MOVE in this Activation, but can't be reactivated for this turn.

sharedRules.name: Passengers (2)
sharedRules.description: Can carry two Infantry with Armour 1 or 2 or one Infantry with Armour 3 or 4.

sharedRules.name: Mythos Creature
sharedRules.description: Immune to Suppression and Critical Hits.

sharedRules.name: Psychic Scream
sharedRules.description: Once per game, execute Psychic Scream Free Action to Attack all Units, friends or foes, in Range 3 radius. Ignores Line of Sight, Infantry and Cover Saves.

sharedRules.name: Lesser Mythos Creatures
sharedRules.description: Can never be the target of any Command Squad, Officer, or Medic Special Actions.

sharedRules.name: Spores
sharedRules.description: Attacks all Units in Range 1 around the Unit. Target Infantry get no Cover Save from this weapon (but still have an Infantry Save).

sharedRules.name: Devour
sharedRules.description: Each time this Hero inflicts one point of Damage in Close Combat, she heals one Health.

sharedRules.name: Passengers (18)
sharedRules.description: Can carry eighteen Infantry with Armour 1 or 2 or nine Infantry with Armour 3 or 4.
